chefSection.heading: Anupama Mukherjee’s Favourite
chefSection.description: Elacher Ghor Cardamom is celebrated by chef Anupama Mukherjee, whose passion for Bengali cuisine and traditional flavours brings a special touch to every creation. Inspired by Bengal’s rich culinary heritage, Elacher Ghor brings the authentic aroma of cardamom to every kitchen.
chefSection.imageAlt: Chef Anupama mukherjee with Elacher ghor Cardamom

gradeSelector.heading: Graded to your Requirement
gradeSelector.description: ‘One size doesn’t fit all’ is true in the case of cardamom as well. Because of their multiple uses and benefits, cardamom pods of different sizes are used in different applications. That is why Elacher Ghor Cardamom is graded by size. However, the grading is never about quality. Whatever the size, quality remains world class.

whyBest.heading: WHAT MAKES US WORLD’S BEST CARDAMOM
whyBest.description: Every pod holds a world of fragrance. Our carefully designed packaging helps keep the natural freshness and distinctive aroma of premium green cardamom intact.
whyBest.provenance: From the lush green plantations of South India, our cardamom is selected for its rich fragrance, refreshing flavour, and exceptional character. Every pack brings the authentic essence of fine Indian cardamom to your kitchen.
